body:
commit 1d89ccb. New cmd/tina-engine: on every real guidance RAISE (var/guidance/articles.ndjson), looks up the source press-release body (var/prwatch-body, keyed by source_identity), drafts a real, disclosure-compliant TINA article via the Anthropic API in the exact house voice/format established by 4 real published TINA posts (read directly from IDUNA/var/blog.db). Deliberate safety boundary: writes drafts only to var/tina-drafts/<id>.json, never auto-publishes -- respects the TINA northstar's own still-open compliance-review question. New main_test.go, 6 tests, all green; go build/vet/test ./... clean across the whole repo, zero regressions. Live-verified: -dry-run against real production data (113 real raise records) correctly resolved 18+ to their exact real source press-release URLs (Deere, Ross Stores, BMO, Medtronic, MongoDB, Workday, Autodesk, and others). Real, honest, external finding: one live (non-dry-run) draft attempt against a real record (Medtronic) hit a genuine Anthropic API error -- credit balance too low. Confirmed this is handled correctly in code: logged, item NOT marked seen, will retry once the account is topped up. This is a real infra/billing gap for the founder, not a code defect. Deliberately deferred, named in the code's own doc comment: the backlog item's architecture note calls for a PARENA-side stdlib/fatbaby.prn FFI declaration for the deterministic detection step, mirroring stdlib/editor/plugin.prn's host/plugin split -- not built this pass, 100% Go today.

⚓ ☃
title: S189-42: real TINA desk engine -- guidance-raise detection + drafting pipeline
